title: Everybody Loves Uncle Bob
description: Everybody needs a fun uncle! Join Uncle Bob and his sock puppet, Warren, for wholesome fun and education.
quote: Good people use good manners, and everybody knows good manners make the world go ’round.
altHero: Uncle Bob, a man with a bowtie and a cowlick, a sock puppet on his hand
alt4: a globe is spinning above Uncle Bob on set
